⚠️ BẠN ĐANG MỞ Ở CHẾ ĐỘ XEM TRƯỚC — ÂM THANH SẼ KHÔNG CHẠY
Ứng dụng Tệp (Files) và Zalo trên iPhone chặn JavaScript, nên nút 🔊, chấm điểm và micro đều bị vô hiệu.
👉 Hãy mở bài học bằng đường link https:// mà giáo viên gửi (bấm vào link trong Zalo ➔ chọn biểu tượng la bàn Safari).
Bấm để máy tự động đọc lần lượt từng từ và hiển thị theo dõi (phù hợp học trên điện thoại)
1. scarcity (n)
/ˈskeəsəti/
sự khan hiếm, sự thiếu hụt nghiêm trọng (tài nguyên nước ngọt, năng lượng)
Collocation: acute water scarcity, resource scarcity, face severe scarcity
"Rapid population growth and climate change have exacerbated freshwater scarcity in arid regions."
2. consumption (n)
/kənˈsʌmpʃn/
lượng tiêu thụ, sự tiêu dùng (nước, điện, thực phẩm — v: consume)
Collocation: per capita water consumption, domestic consumption, industrial consumption
"The table compares daily water consumption per person across five countries in 2025."
3. desalination (n)
/ˌdiːˌsælɪˈneɪʃn/
quá trình khử mặn (biến nước biển thành nước ngọt sinh hoạt)
Collocation: seawater desalination plant, costly desalination technology
"Wealthy desert nations rely heavily on coastal desalination plants to supply drinking water."
4. reservoir (n)
/ˈrezəvwɑː(r)/
hồ chứa nước dự trữ (nhân tạo phía sau đập hoặc tự nhiên)
Collocation: storage reservoir, underground reservoir, water levels in the reservoir
"During the monsoon season, excess rainwater is stored in a massive concrete reservoir."
5. contaminate (v)
/kənˈtæmɪneɪt/
làm ô nhiễm, làm nhiễm độc nguồn nước hoặc đất (n: contamination)
Collocation: contaminate drinking water, be contaminated with toxic chemicals
"Untreated chemical waste from factories has contaminated the local river system."
6. purify (v)
/ˈpjʊərɪfaɪ/
lọc sạch, làm tinh khiết (nước thải hoặc nước sông trước khi cấp cho dân)
Collocation: purify wastewater, water purification plant
"Advanced membrane filters are used to purify recycled water so that it is safe to drink."
7. domestic (adj)
/dəˈmestɪk/
thuộc hộ gia đình, sinh hoạt dân cư (hoặc nội địa trong nước)
Collocation: domestic water use, domestic households, domestic appliances
"In developing nations, domestic households account for less than 12% of total water usage."
8. industrial (adj)
/ɪnˈdʌstriəl/
thuộc ngành công nghiệp, sản xuất nhà máy
Collocation: industrial sector, industrial cooling and manufacturing, industrial waste
"By contrast, the industrial sector in Germany consumes over half of the nation's water supply."
9. catastrophe (n)
/kəˈtæstrəfi/
thảm họa lớn, tai ương (adj: catastrophic — thảm khốc)
Collocation: environmental catastrophe, humanitarian catastrophe, avert a catastrophe
"Failing to conserve freshwater resources could trigger a global humanitarian catastrophe."
10. flood (n/v)
/flʌd/
trận lũ lụt; làm ngập lụt (n: flooding)
Collocation: severe flash floods, flood defences, submerge under floodwater
"Rising sea levels and intense typhoons have increased the frequency of destructive coastal floods."
11. conserve (v)
/kənˈsɜːv/
tiết kiệm, bảo tồn, giữ gìn không lãng phí (nước, năng lượng, thiên nhiên)
Collocation: conserve precious water, conserve energy, water conservation
"Installing rainwater tanks helps domestic households conserve thousands of litres of water annually."
12. average (n/adj)
/ˈævərɪdʒ/
mức trung bình, bình quân (từ khóa trụ cột trong IELTS Task 1 Data Table)
Collocation: an average of 340 litres, above the global average, average daily intake
"Daily water usage in Australia stood at an average of 340 litres per person."
13. notable (adj)
/ˈnəʊtəbl/
đáng chú ý, nổi bật (dùng để nêu đặc điểm chính hoặc ngoại lệ trong Bảng số liệu)
Collocation: with the notable exception of, the most notable feature of the table
"Agriculture dominated water use in all nations, with the notable exception of Germany."
14. disparity (n)
/dɪˈspærəti/
sự chênh lệch lớn, khoảng cách khác biệt rõ rệt giữa các nhóm số liệu
Collocation: a striking disparity between A and B, wide disparity in consumption
"The table reveals a striking disparity in daily per capita water use between rich and poor nations."
15. category (n)
/ˈkætəɡəri/
hạng mục, nhóm phân loại (cột hoặc hàng trong bảng số liệu Task 1)
Collocation: across all three categories, the largest category in the table
"In India, agriculture was by far the largest category, accounting for 88% of total water use."

⚙️ 2. Bài Giảng Ngữ Pháp 2 Tầng (Grammar Masterclass)

🟢 Tầng 1: Chiến Thuật Đọc & Nhóm Bảng Số Liệu (Task 1 Data Table) — Nêu Cực Trị & Ngoại Lệ

• Nguyên tắc sống còn khi viết bài Table: Tuyệt đối KHÔNG liệt kê tuần tự từng con số từ trái qua phải! Hãy nhóm các hàng/cột theo:
  1. Giá trị Cao nhất & Thấp nhất (Extremes) trong từng category (hạng mục).
  2. Ngoại lệ đáng chú ý (Notable Exception) đi ngược quy luật chung.
  3. Sự chênh lệch lớn (Striking Disparity) giữa quốc gia cao nhất và thấp nhất.

• Mẫu câu Overview chuẩn Band 7.5+ cho Bảng số liệu:
  Overall, the most notable feature of the table is that agriculture accounted for the vast majority of water consumption in four countries, with the notable exception of Germany, where the industrial sector dominated. Furthermore, there was a striking disparity in daily per capita water intake between Australia and developing nations.

🔵 Tầng 2: Ghép Đôi Số Liệu Bằng 'Respectively' & Cấu Trúc Đối Lập 'Whereas / By Contrast'

• Gộp 2 quốc gia + 2 con số bằng respectively (tương ứng lần lượt là):
  Ví dụ: India and Egypt recorded the highest proportions in the agricultural category, consuming 88% and 82% of their total water supplies respectively.

• Đối chiếu 2 nhóm ngược chiều bằng By contrast, ... whereas ...:
  Ví dụ: By contrast, Germany exhibited a completely different pattern: its industrial sector accounted for 52% of total water use, whereas agriculture and domestic households represented only 20% and 28% respectively.

🎯 20 Câu Test Từ Vựng (Vocabulary Mastery Test)

1. Over-pumping underground aquifers has led to acute freshwater ________ in many arid countries.
2. The table compares the percentage of total water ________ across three economic sectors in 2025.
3. Because Saudi Arabia has no permanent rivers, it invests heavily in coastal seawater ________ plants.
4. Water levels in the city's main storage ________ dropped to 30% capacity during the summer heatwave.
5. Untreated chemical waste from factories can ________ underground drinking water supplies for decades.
6. Before river water is piped to homes, it passes through a treatment facility to ________ it and kill bacteria.
7. Washing machines, showers, and cooking account for the bulk of ________ water usage in suburban homes.
8. In manufacturing-based economies, the ________ sector consumes vast amounts of water for cooling machinery.
9. Scientists warn that failing to limit global warming could trigger an irreversible environmental ________.
10. Torrential monsoon rains caused the river to burst its banks, resulting in a devastating ________.
11. Public campaigns encourage citizens to turn off taps while brushing their teeth in order to ________ water.
12. Daily domestic water use in Australia stood at an ________ of 340 litres per person.
13. Agriculture was the dominant water user in four countries, with the ________ exception of Germany.
14. The table reveals a striking ________ between the daily water intake of Australia (340L) and India (60L).
15. Across all three economic ________ in the table, domestic households consumed the smallest share of water.
16. [Ôn tập Unit 19] Unless strict anti-poaching laws are enforced, Javan rhinos will face ________.
17. [Ôn tập Unit 18] Adding natural compost helps restore nutrients to degraded ________ without polluting rivers.
18. [Ôn tập Unit 17] Once the steam spins the ________, the generator converts mechanical motion into electricity.
19. [Ôn tập Unit 16] Prolonged stress and lack of sleep can weaken your ________ to viral infections.
20. [Ôn tập Unit 14] E-commerce has grown rapidly; by contrast, traditional brick-and-mortar ________ have declined.
Điểm: 0/20

⚙️ 10 Câu Test Ngữ Pháp Ứng Dụng (Grammar Mastery Test)

1. Overall, agriculture dominated water usage in four nations, with the notable ________ of Germany.
2. India and Egypt recorded the highest agricultural water usage, standing at 88% and 82% ________.
3. There was a striking disparity ________ daily per capita water consumption between Australia (340L) and India (60L).
4. ________ the industrial category accounted for 52% of water consumption in Germany, it represented only 4% in India.
5. In Brazil, domestic water consumption stood ________ 20%, which was slightly higher than industrial use (18%).
6. At 340 litres per day, Australia's per capita water intake was nearly six times ________ that of India (60 litres).
7. Before ________ to domestic households, raw water from the reservoir is purified using sand filters.
8. Across all five nations in the table, India recorded ________ daily water consumption per person, at just 60 litres.
9. Unless governments invest in flood defences and water conservation, coastal cities ________ catastrophic damage.
10. Seawater desalination plants provide a reliable supply of drinking water, ________ they consume vast amounts of electricity.
Điểm: 0/10

👩 Water Utility Officer: Thank you for reporting that, Mr. Miller. Let me check your postcode. Ah, yes—our engineers carried out maintenance work on the Hilltop Reservoir yesterday. 💡 Đáp án câu 2 (Nơi bảo trì hôm qua): Hilltop Reservoir / Reservoir
👨 Resident: That is a relief! I was worried that chemicals had contaminated our drinking water supply.
👩 Water Utility Officer: Not at all! All water leaving the reservoir undergoes strict treatment to purify it, though harmless air bubbles can make it look cloudy for a few hours.
👨 Resident: Thank you. Also, I noticed on my bill that our household water consumption is 330 litres a day, which seems high.
👩 Water Utility Officer: Yes, 330 litres is above the city average of 280 litres per day. 💡 Bẫy số hộ gia đình (330) vs mức trung bình thành phố câu 3: 280
👨 Resident: Do you have any programme to help domestic households conserve water and cut bills?
👩 Water Utility Officer: We certainly do! Under our Conservation Scheme, if you install a garden rainwater tank, the council will refund 150 pounds towards the cost. 💡 Đáp án câu 4 (Số tiền hoàn trả trợ giá): 150
👨 Resident: One hundred and fifty pounds back is a great incentive! Does the company also provide anything for indoor bathrooms?
👩 Water Utility Officer: Yes, our technician can bring a free Eco-Showerhead pack tomorrow, which reduces hot water consumption by 35%. 💡 Đáp án câu 5 (Giảm bao nhiêu % nước nóng): 35

📰 IELTS Academic Reading: Passage & Questions

[Paragraph A - Global Freshwater Scarcity and Climate Disasters]
Although water covers 70% of the Earth's surface, less than 3% of it is freshwater—and two-thirds of that is locked away in polar glaciers. Today, over two billion people live in countries experiencing acute water scarcity. As global temperatures rise, extreme weather has disrupted the water cycle, causing prolonged droughts in some regions while triggering catastrophic floods in others. Without urgent measures to conserve water, humanity could face a severe humanitarian catastrophe.

[Paragraph B - Sectoral Disparities Across Nations (Table Analysis)]
Global statistics reveal a striking disparity in water consumption across three main economic categories: agricultural, industrial, and domestic use. In developing nations such as India and Egypt, farming accounts for over 80% of total water usage. With the notable exception of heavily industrialized economies like Germany, where the industrial sector consumes 52% of the national supply for manufacturing, domestic households typically represent the smallest category. However, daily per capita intake varies wildly: while an Australian uses an average of 340 litres per day, a resident in India uses only 60 litres.

[Paragraph C - Water Contamination, Purification and Desalination]
Compounding physical scarcity is water pollution. In many rapidly urbanizing regions, untreated sewage and toxic industrial chemicals are discharged into rivers, contaminating surface reservoirs. To secure future supplies, arid nations in the Middle East and Singapore have invested heavily in membrane filtration to purify wastewater and coastal desalination plants that turn seawater into drinking water.
Điểm: 0/6

✍️ Academic Writing Lab (IELTS Task 1: Data Table — Tổng Duyệt Chặng 4): So Sánh Bảng Tiêu Thụ Nước Ở 5 Quốc Gia Năm 2025

Đề bài: The table below shows water consumption by three categories (%) and average daily domestic water use per person (litres) in 5 countries in 2025: [Australia: Agriculture 65% | Industrial 15% | Domestic 20% | Daily Use/Person: 340L] • [Germany: Agriculture 20% | Industrial 52% | Domestic 28% | Daily Use/Person: 125L] • [Brazil: Agriculture 62% | Industrial 18% | Domestic 20% | Daily Use/Person: 185L] • [Egypt: Agriculture 82% | Industrial 6% | Domestic 12% | Daily Use/Person: 95L] • [India: Agriculture 88% | Industrial 4% | Domestic 8% | Daily Use/Person: 60L]. Summarize the main features and make comparisons (95 - 125 words).

Tiêu chuẩn Task 1 Data Table: Có Overview nêu xu hướng chính + ngoại lệ của Đức (with the notable exception of Germany) + sự chênh lệch lớn (striking disparity), dùng 'respectively', 'By contrast / whereas' và ít nhất 6 từ vựng Unit 20.
